description: Retrace steps: a curb-cut way back for people with dementia or cognitive impairment who lose their way in a compound, mall or hospital. No map, no location API: the wearer nods at each turn or landmark to drop a breadcrumb anchor recording relative yaw and order, then follows the anchors back in reverse, one segment at a time, confirming each anchor with a nod. Anchors and completed guides persist across sessions.
name: retrace-steps
